content:
Omar (Finance): Noticed CloudBridge said they didn't receive March reseller payout. Partner statement shows $0 for project cloudbridge-prod but our GCP export shows usage.
Priya (Billing Ops): Hm — I pulled the metering export and a bunch of usage lines are attributed to reseller_id NULL for product 'redwood-inference-hosted'. Looks like a tagging/mapping issue during pipeline run on 2028-03-02.
gcp-billing-bot: Daily export processed: gcp_billing_export_2028_03_02.csv upload complete at 2028-03-03T05:12:02Z.
Sam (Partner Success): CloudBridge says their finance team reconciled and flagged a $12,400 shortfall. They want an ETA for payout. They're pretty urgent.
Yuki (Revenue): Can we confirm whether usage was billed to end customers correctly and only the reseller attribution failed? If end customers were billed, we owe the partner the reseller portion.
Priya (Billing Ops): Quick check: `SELECT count(*) FROM gcp_metering WHERE export_date='2028-03-02' AND reseller_id IS NULL AND sku='RWINF-HOST-STD';` -> 124 lines, total_amount 13,200.
Omar (Finance): Ok that aligns with partner delta. Any chance of fixing attribution retroactively in GCP export?
Priya (Billing Ops): GCP doesn't let us rewrite historical exports. We can regenerate internal partner statements and issue a provisional payout/credit memo while we work the support case.
Riya (Legal): Note: our partner agreement allows post-period adjustments within 90 days. Need to record communications and get partner sign-off on provisional payout to avoid disputes.
Sam (Partner Success): I'll tell CloudBridge we're filing a remediation and will push a provisional payment. Want them to sign the acknowledgement.
Priya (Billing Ops): Opening GCP case: case 9876543210. Requesting guidance on attribution fix or best practice for retro mapping.
Omar (Finance): For accounting: we'll book a payable for $13,200 pending confirmation. Nina (FP&A) will need backup for reserve. Tagging @Yuki for revenue recognition impact.
Yuki (Revenue): FYI provisional payout treated as contra-revenue until reconciliation confirmed. Send CSV of impacted invoices.
Priya (Billing Ops): CSV uploaded: https://redwood.app/sheets/gcp-metering-2028 -> sheet "cloudbridge-missing-2028-03". Columns: customer_id, invoice_id, usage_start, usage_end, amount, original_reseller_id.
Sam (Partner Success): CloudBridge ack'd receipt of the provisional note and will sign the simple ack form.
Omar (Finance): Action list: Priya -> follow GCP case and produce final mapping; Sam -> secure partner ack; Yuki -> advise on revenue accounting; Riya -> keep legal looped for ack.
Priya (Billing Ops): ETA for preliminary payout and sheet ready: 90 mins. GCP response expected 24-48h.
Omar (Finance): Marking this P1 until payout/credit is issued. Keep thread updated. :money_with_wings:
Sam (Partner Success): Will update partner and post signed ack here when received.
Priya (Billing Ops): If GCP suggests we can re-export with remapped reseller_id, we'll reconcile and reverse provisional payments.
Omar (Finance): Thanks everyone — please keep replies concise in this thread so we have a single audit trail.
